posts.cooked: Also, you don't NEED a scenario to play the game. Scenarios, in this sort of game, are set ways to play: special rules, alternate win conditions, several players vs. 1, pre-set teams, etc. You can just build your teams and play against each other without using any scenarios if you want, and there's no reason you couldn't make up your own custom scenarios.
